guard: a discovered user-mode space answers cotal status from its registry entry (login row, no no-material refusal) and the components pass probes as the signed-in login, never a raw Authorization Violation
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli build && pnpm smoke:ps-user-mode
why: The ps-user-mode suite already staged the exact machine #1832 describes — a login, a live
user-mode mesh, an empty registry repopulated by catalog discovery — but its bare-status cell
asserted only exit 0 plus the catalog-snapshot line, which is why the defect stayed invisible.
The new cells name the login row, the grant-not-checkable row, the absence of an Authorization
Violation on the components pass, and the signed-out sentence with the exact login command.
SPECIFIER BOUNDARY. The suite runs bin/cotal.ts through tsx but resolves @cotal-ai/auth and
@cotal-ai/cli from dist, so the command builds both before each run and `afterRestore` rebuilds,
or a restored source would sit behind a mutated dist and every later run would grade the wrong
